0.content:
Ningguang's palace floats above Liyue Harbor on plaustrite, a levitating stone she bought in astronomical quantities. It began as a single room and grew until it blots out the moon over Liyue. Only she and three trusted confidants may enter its working rooms. There they pin up summaries of intelligence while she looks out over the city, decides, then shreds everything and throws it out of the window. The falling "paper snow" warns merchants that a change is coming. Save for Mora, it is what she loves most, "because it is infinite", and she means its shadow to reach all seven nations.

In 1.1, when Osial rose, an arcane formation inside the Chamber powered the Guizhong Ballistae; when they failed, she sent the whole palace crashing into the sea onto the god, saying farewell to it as to an old friend. In 2.4 she rebuilt it at an abandoned mine outside the Golden House, needing Sunset Vermillionite (large plaustrite), Wonder Cores and Adepti Sigils. Demand was such that the Feiyun Commerce Guild expected opening bids of at least 500 million Mora for one piece of Sunset Vermillionite.

Beisht appeared as soon as the new Chamber rose; after her defeat Ningguang held a victory banquet aboard it, where Yun Jin debuted her new opera. Many treasures from the old Chamber were lost at sea; salvaged pieces changed hands repeatedly, and she staged an auction to unmask the people holding them. She says she could always destroy another Jade Chamber if it came to that.

1.content:
The Crux's captain flouts Liyue's rules, smuggling exotic goods and claiming to enact justice and keep sailors employed. Ningguang has fined her heavily so often that "the fines she has paid would be enough to buy her a whole new ship". She tried to persuade her privately, gave up, and now asks the Traveler to keep Beidou out of her sight. Yet rumour says Ningguang secretly runs The Crux. Both deny it: Ningguang because she picked Beidou personally, not The Crux, to do her dirty work; Beidou because she works with Ningguang as an equal. Ningguang's verdict: "Beidou is the most reliable person in Liyue." Tell her the truth and what's in it for her, and she will come round.

Beidou thinks Ningguang does good work for the Qixing, and notes that Ningguang, rarely frank, has criticised her very directly. Months before 2.4, Beidou warned her that something was stirring in the deep; Ningguang used that warning to lure out Beisht, and Beidou's fleet fought from the Alcor. They trade barbs at every festival. In 5.3 Ningguang bargained with her over her share of a deal while sending her to guard a gate.

2.content:
The Yuheng once thought Ningguang treated Liyue as nothing but a marketplace, with profit as her only principle. Ningguang thought Keqing too hard-headed and cleaned up after her behind the scenes. When Keqing declared that the time of the adepti had passed and the Qixing must face it, Ningguang's doubts were "dispelled". After Rex Lapis's departure Keqing calls her a comrade in arms, though they still disagree often. When asked whether Liyue is better off with the new Keqing or the old, Ningguang says only time will tell.

In Equilibrium she guessed the Traveler would trust Keqing over her and laughed when proven right. Keqing still fumes that Ningguang bought out months of Lucent Crescents at double price. They fought Osial and Beisht side by side and divide Lantern Rite duties; Ningguang put Keqing in charge of the 2.4 fireworks.

3.content:
Yelan claims to work for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, but she is Ningguang's intelligence agent for national security. They met long before Ningguang was a Qixing and worked together; Yelan jokes she may be partly why Ningguang rose so quickly. Ningguang recommended the job and calls Yelan someone she trusts "unreservedly". In public Yelan calls her "Lady". Yelan's network has kept foreign intelligence rings out of Liyue.

In 5.3 (limited event) Ningguang sent Yelan to find Hu Tao when she failed to return from the border, then assigned her the Gate of Injury in the Chasm. Ningguang quotes Yelan's quip about adepti who "just like hanging around Liyue".

4.content:
Ningguang presided over the 1.1 Rite of Descension; when Rex Lapis's body fell onto the offering table she ordered the exits sealed. She hid the Exuvia and imposed a gag order to keep control and prevent another crisis like Mondstadt's, while letting the Rite of Parting proceed. She denies the Qixing killed their god but admits his passing seems advantageous to them. At the Rite of Parting she told the adepti that Rex Lapis had appeared to her in a dream, and she had dared not speak to him.

Of Zhongli she says only that the Wangsheng consultant knows a great deal and that "excellent pawns" are of no use until she knows their weaknesses. Zhongli praises her as a rare gem, and is the one who remembers her selling wares barefoot along the shore. He also notes the nickname "Tailor of Liyue". Canon never shows her learning who he is.

5.content:
When Tartaglia freed Osial to force Rex Lapis out, Ningguang united the Qixing with the adepti: "we have agreed to put our differences aside for now." The Jade Chamber's formation powered the Guizhong Ballistae with adeptal energy while Fatui troops attacked; she promised Snezhnaya's diplomats would answer "every last one". When the ballistae fell, she asked the Traveler for help and drove the Jade Chamber into the sea onto the wounded god.

Afterward she told the adepti that Liyue would not yield to their wish to return to the old ways. The adepti had protected Liyue under contract for 3,700 years, but she asked them to look at the city and its people, not just the land. She invited the Traveler to help build a new age of prosperity, and later called recruiting them the Qixing's most masterful move.

6.comment: Ningguang: Beisht and the new Jade Chamber
6.content:
In 2.4 Ningguang publicly offered generous pay and one honest answer to the first three people who brought her the rarest materials for a new Jade Chamber. The winners were the Traveler (with Shenhe, who brought the Adepti Sigils), Yun Jin and Beidou. She gave Yun Jin the Chamber as her opera venue and told the Traveler she did not know where the sibling was. When the Chamber rose, Osial's wife Beisht attacked as expected: Ningguang had chosen to rebuild then to draw her out. She declared that in this human age Liyue must overcome the crisis on its own strength, and the Chamber, Keqing's ballistae and Beidou's fleet struck together.

The Traveler was knocked away, and Shenhe followed Beisht beneath the waves to finish her. Ningguang then threw a banquet. She told the Traveler that everyone needs a reason to stay in a place, and promised them work at the highest wage if they ever need Mora.

7.comment: Ningguang: Secretaries, informants and the paper snow
7.content:
Only three trusted confidants may enter the Jade Chamber's working areas; her secretaries Baiwen, Baishi and Baixiao work there. The children of Liyue Harbor are her real "eyes and ears": they report every meeting and newcomer in exchange for treats, and she cross-checks their reports. The rumour that she eavesdrops through enchanted walls is false.

In her hangout she repaired a girl's cheap comb, a keepsake that reminds the girl of her mother, at Mingxing Jewelry for more than it was worth, because trust matters more than profit with these informants. She had not wanted to use children at first; they insisted and she made it a game. She credits it with making them confident and ahead in their studies, and calls her part the duty of a responsible adult. When two businessmen coached one of them to lie in a Luminescent Spine speculation, she called it contemptible and made them pay.

8.comment: Ningguang: The Tianquan and Liyue's laws
8.content:
The Qixing are seven equal leaders named after the Big Dipper's stars; the Tianquan keeps the book of ancient laws set down by Morax and every later amendment, and handles foreign relations. Each Tianquan amends the laws to fit the times; the commentary runs to 279 pages, and every citizen receives a copy. Ningguang likes it so: law and order is good for business, and she knows its intricacies better than anyone. Merchants hunt loopholes; she closes them so fast she is privately nicknamed the "Tailor of Liyue".

Her amendment to the Urban Areas Sanitation Act shows mercy to the careless but "no mercy whatsoever" to anyone who poisons a water source on purpose. Ganyu says her efficient style draws criticism. Yanfei complains of three new laws and 121 revised annotations in a single edition.

9.content: A dead person's Vision is an empty husk and only rarely resonates with someone new. When Ningguang came across one, her first thought was to auction it to the rich. While she sketched the auction, it lit up in her hand. Her attendants congratulated her; she was annoyed. "Once broken, considered sold!" She says there is no need for a Vision where Mora suffices, and knows of only one affair a Vision alone can solve, which she does not name.

10.content: Her invented board game has to-scale boards of Liyue Harbor, dice with many sides, event squares and rules she changes at whim; no one has beaten her, and she is past the 32nd edition. The 8th edition, sold to the public, was still too complex and sells for its models. In her hangout she planned a commemorative set about the battle with Osial, with a limited-edition Traveler piece for full-price pre-orders and a scale Jade Chamber piece, and took the Traveler to Ying'er to be measured.

11.comment: Ningguang: The Northland Bank and the Fatui
11.content: After the Osial incident she imposed a punishing reparations payment on Snezhnaya, which the Northland Bank paid. Diplomatic ties were strained but not broken, and the bank still distrusts her. In her hangout, a brief visit prompted the bank to put her under surveillance; she turned the tail, offered him immunity for cooperation, and returned to confront the bank. She warns the Traveler that the bank is more than a commercial organisation.

12.comment: Ningguang: Hangout - The Jade Chamber's Returning Guest
12.content: With her secretaries tied up running an auction, Ningguang asked the Traveler to plan her next day. Branches: a business lunch for which a merchant paid tens of millions of Mora, where she dismissed the Luminescent Spine craze as hype; hosting the auction herself to trap the people holding her salvaged treasures; meeting her child informants; or a day off. On the day off she might play at starting from nothing: scavenge the docks, fight monsters for chests, chase a Weasel Thief, catch fish by hand and grill them charred, and talk about her mother and her childhood. Or she might commission the Liyue Millennial set and confess her grief over the Chamber. Endings range from "The Weight of a Collection" to "Feint and Riposte" ("No one wants to have to go up against Ningguang...").

13.comment: Ningguang: Ningguang at Lantern Rite and festivals
13.content: Limited-time events, canon but not universally known. Moonlight Merriment (2.1): she took custody of a giant stone Beidou found, left it to Keqing and sparred verbally with Beidou over her "simple" tastes. Fleeting Colors in Flight (2.4): she planned a Ministry of Civil Affairs fireworks show to warm the city's heart after recent events and admitted that leading everything is exhausting. The Exquisite Night Chimes (3.4): she organised a concert with the Iridescence Tour and explained that year's Mingxiao Lantern honoured the Sea Gazer.

14.content: During the limited 5.3 Lantern Rite, an illness spread among Qingce's elderly and something stirred at Wuwang Hill. When Hu Tao, Qiqi and Lan Yan went missing in the border, Ningguang asked the Traveler to rescue them with the Conqueror of Demons' guidance. She then coordinated an eight-gate array across Liyue: Keqing, Ganyu, Beidou, Yelan, the Conqueror of Demons and the Bubu Pharmacy pair each held a gate, Hu Tao's was the Gate of Death, and she and Lan Yan held the Gate of Initiation in the harbour. Homa altars and the funeral parlor's secret art burned out the fetor.

15.content: At the Lantern Rite of the Luna IV version (6.3), strange moon incidents troubled Liyue. Ningguang, at Yujing Terrace with Keqing and Lan Yan, said the Qixing were interpreting ancient artifacts while Ganyu consulted the adepti. Shown a picture taken at Chiwang Terrace, she noted that the moon looked less eaten than obscured and connected Chenyu Vale's ancient migrants to the Chasm. The affair revealed a new adeptus, the White Horse Adeptus, whose taste for travel Ningguang finds a relief.

key: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon
16.content: During the limited 7.1 Moonchase event in Chenyu Vale, Ningguang came to Yilong Wharf on official business. Malevolent forces gather each year at this season and possess monsters, so the Millelith traditionally join civilian thaumaturges such as the Lan clan. She explained that Moonchase customs come from the people, not from official rules, and asked the Traveler to enjoy the festival like anyone else. When an art cast by Lan Yan suppressed the spirits across Liyue, letting the Millelith go home early, she visited the clan to thank her in person.

17.content: In the Anecdote "Ningguang: Solemn Duty", the Traveler found her with a cold from sleepless strain. Dr. Baizhu, who comes often to adjust her prescriptions, urged rest; she asked only for more medicine. Her reason: if she stopped, the whole Ministry of Civil Affairs would get a headache, and then Liyue Harbor itself would catch cold.
